title: Why You Feel Drained After Socializing
description:
Why do you feel drained after socializing, even when you had a great time? Researchers at the University of Helsinki checked in on people five times a day for 12 days. Being sociable lifted their mood in the moment, but they felt more tired about three hours later, extroverts included. Here's what that means for your social battery.

Follow The Human Side for more on the things we feel but rarely talk about.
source: Leikas & Ilmarinen (2017), Happy Now, Tired Later?, Journal of Personality
tags: why do I feel tired after socializing
pinned_comment: How long does it take you to recharge after a big night out? 👇

scenes.text: You had a great night out. So why do you feel this drained?
It's not because you secretly hate people.
Researchers in Finland checked in on people five times a day for nearly two weeks.
Being sociable lifted their mood in the moment.
But about three hours later, they felt more tired.
A big part of it was simply how many people they'd been around.
Being around people costs energy, even when you love them.
So next time, plan a quiet evening after a busy one.
Because you'll want to say yes again.
